text.p: These are the highlights of the main Sao Paulo and Rio de Janeiro newspapers this morning.
GAZETA MERCANTIL
-- TO DEVALUATE THE REAL WOULD BE A MISTAKE-DORNBUSCH

Economist Rudiger Dornbusch says it would be a terrible mistake to devaluate the Real, which would only create enormous instability, given the size of Brazil's fiscal deficit and the economy's level of openess.
-- FOOD INDUSTRY MAKES GAINS WITH THE REAL
Turnover in the food industry has grown 11 percent between 1994 and 1996 due to increased buying power since the introduction of the anti-inflation Real Plan in 1994.
FOLHA DE SAO PAULO
-- UNITED STATES WANTS BRAZIL ECONOMY TO OPEN FASTER
The United States government says it wants the Brazilian economy to open up faster and provide a genuine opening for U.S. industries.
-- CVRD GOLD RESERVES TO DOUBLE WITH NEW DEPOSIT
The new gold deposit discovered by state mining giant CVRD in October last year should double the company's gold reserves and raise its privatization price.
-- SHOOTING LEAVES FIVE DEAD AND FOUR INJURED
Five people were killed and four seriously injured in a shooting believed to have been over the control of drug sales.
O GLOBO
-- CARDOSO TRIES TO ENSURE PMDB VICTORY IN LOWER HOUSE VOTE

President Fernando Henrique Cardoso wants the candidate of the PMDB party, Michel Temer, to win the vote for the presidency of the Chamber of Deputies, a move Cardoso considers essential for his re-election hopes.
-- CAR ACCIDENT KILLS SINGER CHICO SCIENCE
Pop singer and composer Chico Science died in a car accident at age 30 near the northeastern city of Recife.
-- Reuters has not verified the stories and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
